[[Pakhtakor Tashkent]] were the defending champions from the 2019 campaign. ==Season events== On 16 March, all football competitions in Uzbekistan were postponed due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://championat.asia/t/y0wvAp0T|title=O'zbekistondagi futbol-klublari mashgulotlari ham bekor qilindi|publisher=Championat.asia|date=16 March 2020|access-date=23 March 2020}} On 20 July, the Uzbekistan Super League was suspended for a second time due to [[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]], with it being announced on 24 July that the league would resume on 3 August with the scheduled 10th round matches.{{cite web |title=Coca Cola Суперлиганинг 10-тур учрашувлари қолдирилди |url=https://www.fcbunyodkor.com/news/detail/12957 |website=fcbunyodkor.com |publisher=FC Bunyodkor |access-date=25 July 2020 |language=uz |date=20 July 2020}}{{cite web |title=Coca Cola Суперлига 3 августдан давом эттирилади |url=https://www.fcbunyodkor.com/news/detail/12959 |website=fcbunyodkor.com |publisher=FC Bunyodkor |access-date=25 July 2020 |language=uz |date=24 July 2020}} ==Teams==
